$comment: Inputs for the Android shell. Everything the TWA build and the dApp Store
listing need that is NOT already in apps/web/public/manifest.webmanifest.
SET `domain` BEFORE BUILDING. It is baked into the APK in two places that
must agree — the URL the shell opens, and the Digital Asset Links check that
removes the browser chrome — so it cannot be changed after publishing without
shipping a new APK. build-apk.sh refuses to run while it is the placeholder.
`applicationId` is the permanent Android identity of the app. Changing it
later means a NEW listing, not an update: users would have to uninstall and
reinstall, losing nothing on-chain but every local setting. Choose once.
name: Pixel Kingdom Wars
